definitions.explanation: Continuing indefinitely without change; intended to remain in place or effect forever.

examples.japanese: {恒久的|こうきゅうてき}な{平和|へいわ}を{実現|じつげん}したい。
examples.english: I want to achieve lasting peace.

examples.japanese: これは{恒久的|こうきゅうてき}な{解決策|かいけつさく}ではない。
examples.english: This is not a permanent solution.

examples.japanese: {恒久的|こうきゅうてき}な{制度|せいど}として{確立|かくりつ}された。
examples.english: It was established as a permanent system.

examples.japanese: {恒久的|こうきゅうてき}に{保存|ほぞん}する{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: It needs to be preserved permanently.

notes:
USAGE: {恒久的|こうきゅうてき} is a formal word used in political, legal, and academic contexts. It emphasizes unchanging, eternal quality.

NOUN: {恒久|こうきゅう} (permanence)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{恒久的|こうきゅうてき}な{平和|へいわ} (lasting peace)
・{恒久的|こうきゅうてき}な{解決|かいけつ} (permanent solution)
・{恒久的|こうきゅうてき}な{施設|しせつ} (permanent facility)
・{恒久的|こうきゅうてき}に{保存|ほぞん}する (preserve permanently)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{永久|えいきゅう}: Eternal, everlasting (more literary)
・{恒久的|こうきゅうてき}: Permanent (formal, policy-oriented)
・{暫定的|ざんていてき}: Provisional (antonym - temporary)
・{一時的|いちじてき}: Temporary (antonym)
